Veela tells herself, “It’s gonna be okay, because Lou is Vee’s best friend in the whole wide world...!” If Veela is attacked, and her remaining HP percentage falls below 40%, this skill dispels all debuffs from her. This skill will not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation.
Additionally grants Veela [Shield] equal to 300% of her ATK for 2 turn.
The number of turns of [Shield] becomes 3.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Bow-Wow-WOW! The amount all targets’ ATK increases by becomes 20%, and the amount all targets’ DEF increases by becomes 70%.
Strengthens Spirit’s Aegis. The amount all ally targets’ CRIT DMG Boost increases by becomes 30%.
Strengthens Happiness. The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 200% of her ATK.

levels.text: “Bow-Wow-WOW!” With these magic words, Chiffon helps her friends out. Increases all allies’ DEF by 50% for 4 turns.
Additionally increases all targets’ ATK by 10% for 4 turns.
Additionally grants all targets [Shield] equal to 100% of Chiffon’s ATK for 2 turns.

“Spirit’s Aegis...huh? Th-This is the wrong magic spell!” After conjuring this magic spell by mistake, Chiffon has no idea what will happen next. This skill selects 5 random targets out of all enemies and allies. If an ally is a target, this skill restores HP equal to 50% of Chiffon’s ATK to them. If an enemy is a target, this skill deals 1 magical attack equal to 200% of Chiffon’s ATK to them, decreasing their chance to resist a critical hit by 30% and inflicting [Sleep] on them for 1 turn. These 2 effects are treated as 1 debuff, and are both dispelled when the target is attacked. This skill ignores [Taunt] and [Stealth] if a target is enhanced with either of them.
If an ally is a target, additionally increases their CRIT DMG Boost by 15% for 1 turn.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 300% of her ATK.
The amount all ally targets’ HP is restored by becomes equal to 100% of Chiffon’s ATK, and the number of turns of [Increased CRIT DMG Boost] becomes 2.
Chiffon experiences true happiness at last... A warmth that she has never known before cradles her wounded heart. Increases both her max HP and DEF by 15% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally, at the start of the 1st turn, grants the ally with the highest ATK other than Chiffon [Shield] equal to 150% of Chiffon’s ATK for 1 turn.
The amounts her max HP and DEF increase by each become 30%.

“No matter how painful or scary things get, I’ll hang on, I will...” Chiffon’s perseverance becomes a power that protects her. When she is attacked and takes damage that exceeds 10% of her max HP, the damage is cut by 20%. At the start of each turn, the potency of the damage cutting decreases by 2%. This skill will not activate after the start of the 11th turn.
The damage from the enemy’s attack is cut by 30%. At the start of each turn, the potency of the damage cutting decreases by 3%.
The damage from the enemy’s attack is cut by 40%. At the start of each turn, the potency of the damage cutting decreases by 4%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Shut Up, Shut Up!! The decrease in the target’s chance to evade becomes 50%.
Strengthens No Looking, No Laughing!! The max amount the physical attack’s damage can increase by becomes 1800% of her ATK.
Strengthens Shut Up, Shut Up!! The number of turns of [Decreased Chance to Evade] becomes 3.

levels.text: Lea flies into a rage and frantically swings her weapon. After decreasing the chance to evade of the enemy with the highest ATK by 30% for 2 turns, she deals 1 physical attack equal to 700% of her ATK to them. Afterwards, this skill has an 80% chance to inflict [Fainted] on the target for 1 turn.

Additionally, after the decision to inflict [Fainted] has been made, if the target is not afflicted with [Fainted], this skill deals 1 physical attack equal to 900% of Lea’s ATK to them (if the target has already been defeated, this additional attack will not activate). This attack is guaranteed to hit.
Additionally, if the target is not defeated by this skill, it reactivates (1 reactivation max).

Lea’s riled emotions will not wane until she kills her opponent. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 800% of her ATK to the enemy with the highest ATK. If the target is afflicted with [Decreased Chance to Evade], the physical attack’s damage is multiplied by 1.5.
Additionally, if the target is not afflicted with [Decreased Chance to Evade], this attack is guaranteed to hit.
Additionally, the lower her remaining HP percentage is decreased, the more the physical attack’s damage is increased (1200% of her ATK max).
The max amount the physical attack’s damage can increase by becomes 1600% of her ATK.

“I gotta g-g-get them...! B-Before they kill me...I gotta kill them first!” The excessive delusions running through Lea’s mind make her even more aggressive, increasing her ATK by 15% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally increases her CRIT DMG Boost by 15% (cannot be dispelled).
The amounts her ATK and CRIT DMG Boost increase by each become 35%.

“They’re laughing... Th-They’re laughing at me... I’m sure of it...” A prisoner to the laughter that only she can hear, Lea has lived each day avoiding the gazes of others. At the start of the battle, this skill grants [Stealth] to Lea for 1 turn.
The number of turns of [Stealth] becomes 2.

Additionally, if Lea is attacked and takes damage that exceeds 25% of her max HP, decreases the damage she takes by 15% for 2 turns. This skill will not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Rampaging Dragon!! The amount her HP is restored by becomes equal to 15% of this skill’s total damage.
Strengthens My Way of Life. The damage from the enemy’s attack is cut by 20%. The lower her remaining HP percentage is, the more the potency of damage cutting is increased (80% max).
Strengthens Dragons’ Cross!! The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 1000% of her ATK.

levels.text: Claudia’s slashes evoke the image of a dragon god consumed by fury. Deals 2 physical attacks equal to 600% of her ATK to enemies at random. The sand in Claudia’s hourglass does not stop trickling down. Thus, she will continue fighting until the last grain drops. The lower her remaining HP percentage is, the more the physical attacks’ damage is increased (1350% of her ATK max). However, the decision to increase Claudia’s ATK based on her remaining HP percentage is made with each individual attack this skill deals.
Additionally restores HP equal to 5% of this skill’s total damage to her.
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 800% of her ATK (1800% of her ATK max).

“I can’t afford to go down just yet!” If Claudia’s remaining HP percentage is below 50%, this skill decreases the chance to evade of the enemy with the highest ATK by 50% and inflicts [Fainted] on them for 2 turns. These 2 effects are treated as 1 debuff. “Time for your sun to set... Dragons’ Cross!!” Afterwards, regardless of whether the debuff is inflicted on the target or not, this skill deals 1 physical attack equal to 500% of Claudia’s ATK to them. If Claudia is enhanced with [Ready to Die], this skill restores HP equal to 15% of this skill’s total damage to her.
Additionally, if she is not enhanced with [Ready to Die], the physical attack’s damage is multiplied by 2.
Additionally, if the target is not defeated by this skill, before restoring HP, the debuff infliction and physical attack reactivate (1 reactivation max).
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 900% of her ATK.

Claudia is prepared to burn her life away to conquer the enemy. This resolve enhances her power. At the start of the battle, this skill grants [Ready to Die] to her for 40 turns. The less time Claudia has left, the sharper and more brilliant her blades become. [Ready to Die] increases Claudia’s ATK by 40%, and each turn, at the start of the action phase, she deals damage equal to 20% of her current HP to herself (this damage will not exceed 100% of the enhanced target’s ATK). These 2 effects are treated as 1 buff.
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 60%.
The amount her ATK increases by becomes 80%.

“Undefeated, unrivaled, and all-powerful. That’s the founder—no. That’s me.” Increases Claudia’s max HP by 30% (cannot be dispelled). When she is attacked, the attack’s damage is cut by 5%. The lower her remaining HP percentage is, the more the potency of damage cutting is increased (20% max).
The damage from the enemy’s attack is cut by 10%. The lower her remaining HP percentage is, the more the potency of damage cutting is increased (40% max).
The amount her max HP increases by becomes 60%.

members.name: The Witch of Snowy Illusions · Lunalynn
Shining Star of Holy Darkness · Stella

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Spell of Chaos. The chance to inflict [Silence] becomes 40%. If a target’s STR is lower than Stella’s STR, the chance to inflict [Silence] on that target becomes 80%.
Strengthens Sovereign of the Stars. The chance to inflict [Silence] becomes 80%.
At the start of the battle, increases her SPD by 25% for 1 turn (cannot be dispelled).

levels.text: “As the supreme ruler of darkness, I hereby command you...to perish!” Chanting a spell of her own creation, Stella deals 1 physical attack equal to 300% of her ATK to the 2 enemies with the lowest remaining HP percentages, and has a 20% chance to inflict [Silence] on all targets for 1 turn. “Please go down, please go down, please go down...!” The power in Stella’s words turns into a curse that stops enemies in their tracks. If a target’s STR is lower than Stella’s STR, the chance to inflict [Silence] on that target becomes 40%.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 400% of her ATK.
The targets of this skill become the 3 enemies with the lowest remaining HP percentages.

“It appears that the time to remove this seal has come at last!” The great power that Stella had sealed beneath her eyepatch is set free. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 800% of her ATK to the enemy with the highest ATK, and restores HP equal to 25% of this skill’s total damage to the ally with the lowest remaining HP percentage.
The amount the target’s HP is restored by becomes 50% of this skill’s total damage.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 1000% of her ATK.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 1200% of her ATK.

After many years of continuous practice, a spell of Stella’s own creation transforms from mere words into true magic. At the start of the 1st turn, this skill grants Stella [Shield] equal to 400% of her ATK for 3 turns (cannot be dispelled).
The number of turns of [Shield] becomes 6.
The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 800% of her ATK.

“The boss’s light will always protect me...” At the start of the battle, this skill increases Stella’s DEF by 25% for 10 turns. When she is attacked, the number of turns of this skill’s [Increased DEF] decreases by 1. When Stella is attacked while she is not enhanced with this skill’s [Increased DEF], this skill increases Stella’s DEF by 25% for 10 turns, and has a 40% chance to inflict [Silence] on 5 random enemies for 1 turn. If she is defeated by the attack, this skill will not activate.
The amount her DEF increases by becomes 50%.
The number of turns of [Silence] becomes 2.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens It’s Do-or-Die! The amount all targets’ M. DEF is decreased by becomes 40%, and the increase in the damage they take becomes 20%.
Strengthens Evil Sword’s Creator. The amount of damage that exceeds 5% of her max HP is cut by 90%.
Strengthens Sword of Calamity. The magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 200% of her ATK.

levels.text: Artie yells, “It’s do-or-die. Fight back!” From her magic circle, she summons swords that have performed miracles across a great number of battlefields, and rains them all down onto her opponents. Deals 1 magical attack equal to 350% of Artie’s ATK to 5 random enemies. “I’ll make sure you have no way to defend against this...!” There are times when the simple desire to protect lives greatly turns the tide of battle. Before dealing the magical attack, this skill decreases all targets’ M. DEF by 20% and increases the damage they take by 10% for 2 turns.

Additionally, if Artie is enhanced with Evil Sword’s Creator’s [Increased Chance to Resist a Critical Hit] buff, this skill grants her 2 stacks of a buff that increases her chance to resist a critical hit by 10%. If Artie is not enhanced with Evil Sword’s Creator’s [Increased Chance to Resist a Critical Hit] buff, this skill grants her 3 stacks of the buff (10 stacks max) (cannot be dispelled).
The numbers of turns of [Decreased M. DEF] and [Increased Damage Taken] each become 4.

“If I can end the fighting...!” Artie uses her magic to create a copy of the evil sword, dealing 5 magical attacks equal to 170% of her ATK to enemies at random. There are times when the desire to bring an end to war will distort one’s ray of hope. Before dealing the magical attacks, if a target’s remaining HP percentage is lower than Artie’s remaining HP percentage, the magical attack’s damage to that target is multiplied by 1.5.
Additionally, before dealing the magical attacks, if a target is afflicted with a debuff, this skill is guaranteed to deal a critical hit to that target.
The number of magical attacks becomes 7. Additionally restores HP equal to 20% of this skill’s total damage to Artie.
Before dealing the magical attacks, if a target’s remaining HP percentage is lower than Artie’s remaining HP percentage, the magical attack’s damage to that target is multiplied by 2.

“The two of us can overcome anything.” Time after time, when Artie’s heart is on the verge of shattering, that inseparable presence gives her the strength to pick herself back up. Increases Artie’s max HP by 15% (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally decreases the damage she takes by 15% (cannot be dispelled).
The amount her max HP increases by becomes 30%, and the decrease in the damage she takes becomes 30%.

The powerful magic power that once created that evil sword turns into a power that protects Artie. At the start of the battle, this skill grants her 3 stacks of a buff that increases her chance to resist a critical hit by 10% (10 stacks max) (cannot be dispelled). When she is attacked and takes damage that exceeds 5% of her max HP, the stack count of this skill’s [Increased Chance to Resist a Critical Hit] buff is depleted by 1, and the exceeding amount of damage is cut by 50%.
The amount of damage that exceeds 5% of her max HP is cut by 70%.
The number of stacks of the [Increased Chance to Resist a Critical Hit] buff granted to her becomes 8.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Tranquilizing Dart. The targets of this skill become the enemy directly in front of her and the 2 enemies adjacent to that target.
Strengthens Silver Weaver. The number of turns of [Bleed] becomes 2.
Strengthens Tranquilizing Dart. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 980% of her ATK.

levels.text: Eir takes aim at the enemy, firing a tranquilizing dart that can cause even the largest of beasts to fall unconscious. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 580% of her ATK to the enemy directly in front of her and 1 enemy adjacent to that target. This skill has a 50% chance to decrease the target’s chance to resist a critical hit by 40% and inflicting [Sleep] on them for 2 turns. These 2 effects are treated as 1 debuff, and are both dispelled when the target is attacked.
The chance to inflict [Decreased Chance to Resist a Critical Hit] and [Sleep] becomes 70%.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 880% of her ATK.

Eir aims for her prey’s vitals, stopping them in their tracks. This is the most basic, yet most effective hunting technique...whether her prey be beast, or witch. Activates when there is 1 or more enemy afflicted with an effect from an action hindering debuff. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 480% of Eir’s ATK to all enemies afflicted with effects from action hindering debuffs (5 targets max) (if there are more than 5 targets, 5 out of those targets will be selected at random). If Eir does not fulfill the activation requirement, she instead deals 1 basic attack.
Additionally inflicts [Bleed] on all targets for 1 turn. Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Bleed] deals damage equal to 50% of Eir’s ATK.
The physical attack becomes guaranteed to hit.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 880% of her ATK.

Seeing her weakened prey, Eir mercifully puts a swift end to their struggle. A testament to the hunter’s integrity imparted by her grandfather. At the start of each turn, if there is 1 or more enemy afflicted with an effect from an action hindering debuff, this skill increases Eir’s SPD by 15%, and ATK by 30% for 1 turn (cannot be dispelled).
At the start of each turn, additionally, if there are no enemies afflicted with effects from action hindering debuffs, grants Eir [Shield] equal to 500% of her ATK for 1 turn (cannot be dispelled).
The amount her SPD increases by becomes 30%. The amount her ATK increases by becomes 60%.

“I’ve decided that if becoming a pawn, even for demons, allows me to protect my little sister...I’ll do it.” Strengthens Eir’s basic attack. When she deals a basic attack, she instead deals 1 physical attack equal to 150% of her ATK to 2 random enemies.
Additionally has a 30% chance to inflict [Sleep] on all targets for 1 turn. [Sleep] is dispelled when a target is attacked.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 200% of her ATK.

members.name: A Trace of Days Gone By · Fia

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Life Reaver. The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.
Strengthens The Power Over Death. The amount Fia’s 2 adjacent allies’ max HP increases by becomes 50% of Fia’s max HP.
Strengthens The Power She Left Me. The amount her HP is restored by becomes equal to 30% of the damage taken (15% of her max HP max).

levels.text: The curse of eternal life sometimes steals someone else’s life force, and makes it one with Fia’s. Increases her HP Drain by 20% for 2 turns, and deals 1 physical attack equal to 380% of her ATK to 3 random enemies.
The number of turns of [Increased HP Drain] becomes 4, and the amount her HP Drain increases by becomes 40%.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 480% of her ATK.

Life and death are two sides of the same coin. But, the curse of eternal life severs death from that coin, delivering retribution upon Fia’s enemies. Deals 1 direct attack equal to 10% of the total damage taken by her over the past 20 turns to 2 random enemies.
The direct attack’s damage becomes equal to 15% of the total damage taken by her over the past 20 turns.
The targets of this skill become 3 random enemies.
The direct attack’s damage becomes equal to 20% of the total damage taken by her over the past 20 turns.

Fia’s overabundant life force no longer affects her alone—it also becomes entangled with the life forces of her allies. At the start of the battle, this skill increases 1 adjacent ally’s max HP by 20% of Fia’s max HP (cannot be dispelled). Afterwards, this skill increases Fia’s max HP by 40% (cannot be dispelled).
The amount Fia’s max HP increases by becomes 100%.
The ally targets whose max HP are increased become 2 adjacent allies.

With her dying breath, a witch used a power that could have possibly destroyed the world to save one girl. At the start of the turn, this skill increases the Counter of the ally with the lowest SPD by 5% for 1 turn. If Fia is the target of this skill, the amount her Counter increases by becomes 20%. This skill will not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation.
Additionally, when Fia is attacked, restores HP equal to 20% of the damage taken to her (10% of her max HP max). If she is defeated by the attack, this skill will not activate.

The number of turns of [Increased Counter] becomes 2, and the amount the target’s Counter increases by becomes 10%. If Fia is the target of this skill, the amount her Counter increases by becomes 30%.
